item.title: Correction · Humboldt Street Plaza: The Humboldt Street Plaza page no longer calls the plaza small
item.description: The Humboldt Street Plaza page no longer calls the plaza small. It now says the plaza is part of the adopted design standards, that the October 7, 2020 Phase 1 approval lists it in Phase 2 and requires it to be delivered before the first certificate of occupancy for the building that takes the project to 3 million square feet (a trigger, not a date), and that no source gives a design approval, construction start or opening. Source: https://sfplanning.org/sites/default/files/documents/citywide/potreropower_D4D_final.pdf ; https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station (October 2020 Phase 1 and Phasing Plan Amendment Approval).
item.source: https://sfplanning.org/sites/default/files/documents/citywide/potreropower_D4D_final.pdf ; https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station (October 2020 Phase 1 and Phasing Plan Amendment Approval)

item.title: Correction · Humboldt Street Plaza: The 2031 expected completion was removed: it came from a 2020…
item.description: The 2031 expected completion was removed: it came from a 2020 press forecast of Phase 2's window that has not held, and the plaza's actual delivery trigger is a 3-million-sq-ft occupancy milestone with no sourced date. In its place the timeline cites the Port Commission's November 2025 memo saying open space is tied to vertical development expected over the next 10-15 years. The landscape architect entry was removed because the Design for Development credits CMG Landscape Architecture only for precedent photographs. The 2024 compliance-report milestone now says that report does not mention the plaza, and the trigger is attributed to the 2021 report. The dead 2019 draft link was replaced with the final February 2020 document and the land-use figure is tagged as a document rather than a rendering. Source: Port of San Francisco, Port Commission Item 10A memo, 2025-11-14 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2025-11/111825_10a_potrero_power_station_lease_amendment_0.pdf); SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Design for Development, final, 2020-02-26 (https://sfplanning.org/sites/default/files/documents/citywide/potreropower_D4D_final.pdf); California Barrel Company, 2021 Annual Report, 2022-03 (https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station); California Barrel Company, 2024 Annual Compliance Report, 2025-03-28 (https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station).
item.source: Port of San Francisco, Port Commission Item 10A memo, 2025-11-14 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2025-11/111825_10a_potrero_power_station_lease_amendment_0.pdf); SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Design for Development, final, 2020-02-26 (https://sfplanning.org/sites/default/files/documents/citywide/potreropower_D4D_final.pdf); California Barrel Company, 2021 Annual Report, 2022-03 (https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station); California Barrel Company, 2024 Annual Compliance Report, 2025-03-28 (https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station)

item.title: Planned · Humboldt Street Plaza: Port Commission staff memo says the project's… (Nov 14, 2025)
item.description: Port Commission staff memo says the project's public access and open space improvements are tied to completion of vertical development, expected to be phased over the next 10-15 years; the plaza's own delivery trigger is the first certificate of occupancy for the building representing 3 million sq ft of total development, and no calendar date is sourced (Nov 14, 2025). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2025-11-14; California Barrel Company / SF Planning (M-Files: 'Potrero Power Station Phase 1 and Phasing Plan Amendment Applications'), 2020-10.
item.source: Port of San Francisco, 2025-11-14; California Barrel Company / SF Planning (M-Files: 'Potrero Power Station Phase 1 and Phasing Plan Amendment Applications'), 2020-10

item.title: Planned · Humboldt Street Plaza: 2024 annual compliance report (March 2025) does not… (Mar 2025)
item.description: 2024 annual compliance report (March 2025) does not mention Humboldt Street Plaza and lists no design review or permitting activity for it; the plaza's Phase 2 status and 3-million-sq-ft delivery trigger are in the 2021 annual report's phasing table (Mar 2025). Source: California Barrel Company LLC (developer's compliance report, posted by SF Planning, M-Files), 2022-03; California Barrel Company LLC (developer's compliance report, posted by SF Planning, M-Files), 2025-03.

item.title: Milestone · Humboldt Street Plaza: Phasing Plan amendment approved: Humboldt Street… (Oct 7, 2020)
item.description: Phasing Plan amendment approved: Humboldt Street Plaza moved from DA Phase 1 to Phase 2, 'required to be delivered prior to the City's issuance of the First Certificate of Occupancy for the Building representing 3 million square feet of total development' (Oct 7, 2020). Source: California Barrel Company / SF Planning (M-Files: 'Potrero Power Station Phase 1 and Phasing Plan Amendment Applications'), 2020-10; California Barrel Company LLC (developer's compliance report, posted by SF Planning, M-Files), 2022-03.
item.source: California Barrel Company / SF Planning (M-Files: 'Potrero Power Station Phase 1 and Phasing Plan Amendment Applications'), 2020-10; California Barrel Company LLC (developer's compliance report, posted by SF Planning, M-Files), 2022-03

item.title: Milestone · Humboldt Street Plaza: Planning Commission certifies the Final EIR… (Jan 30, 2020)
item.description: Planning Commission certifies the Final EIR (Motion No. 20635) and approves the Design for Development (Motion No. 20638) on January 30, 2020, per the recitals of Planning Commission Resolution No. 21156; the final D4D document is dated Feb 26, 2020, and its Section 4.24 sets the plaza's standards (Jan 30, 2020). Source: SF Planning; SF Planning (hosts the D4D; the D4D names no author), 2020-02-26; SF Planning Commission, 2022-07-28.
